title: A vet clinic group whose services state different access checks
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #2054, phase 2). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: The case exists for issue #2054. It measures the assertion pass on the authorization-scope predicates. The source states each part on its own element: the owner API checks that a pet belongs to the owner (each request yes, ownership yes); the clinic API checks only that a staff account signed in (each request no) and gives every staff account every permission (least privilege no); both APIs use the database's admin account (least privilege no, on each connection). The lab results importer does not check whether the lab may send a result (each request no), and the billing service's role check is a hedge that must stay unknown. The tampering must-find rests on the importer's stated missing check. The elevation-of-privilege must-find rests on the staff accounts' stated full access. The domain is a vet clinic group, which no other case covers.
